frontmatter.description: Extract ONE concept and its vocabulary from an existing corpus into a source-anchored, deduplicated concept pack grouped by facet. TRIGGER: "abstract X out of Y", "everything about X in these docs", "build a concept pack", "cross-source reference for X", "/lca".
